articleTitle: Crystal Orientation Dependence of Low-Temperature Bonding Using Germanium and Diamond Substrates
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Bonding formation is possibly affected by crystal orientations, which are deeply related to surface reaction. This study compared the crystal orientation dependence on the bonding strength using Ge and diamond substrates. The bonding of the Ge (100) and (111) surfaces is similar; however, that of diamond (100) and (111) surfaces significantly differs. Understanding the relationship between crystal orientation and bonding formation can contribute to the design of next-generation semiconductors.

articleTitle: Influence of Annealing-Induced Edge Voids in Wafer-to-Wafer (W2W) Direct Bonding
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Wafer-to-wafer (W2W) hybrid bonding is a crucial enabler of higher performance electronic devices. Water desorption during the annealing process facilitates the formation of interfacial voids and degrades bonding reliability. In this work, we focus on edge voids using two different types of SiCN as a bonding dielectric film.

articleTitle: Recent Progress in Surface Activated Bonding for 3D and Heterogeneous Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: This paper presents advancements in surface activated bonding (SAB) for wafer-scale bonding of diamond materials to WBG semiconductors. By utilizing the Gas Cluster Ion Beam (GCIB) technique, sub-nanometer smoothing of diamond surfaces is achieved, a critical requirement for effective SAB. Furthermore, the paper introduces an All-Metal 3D Interconnect as an alternative to conventional hybrid bonding, which typically necessitates high temperatures. The All-Metal approach uses Cu exclusively for bonding signal lines and electrodes, enabling a unified bonding mechanism entirely at room temperature and addressing the challenges associated with integrating heterogeneous semiconductors.

articleTitle: Surface Activated Cu/SiO2 Hybrid Bonding for Room Temperature 3D Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Surface activated bonding (SAB) was used to bond two hybrid surfaces. 200 mm wafers with 2.5 μm copper pads 2.5 μm apart in a silicon oxide matrix were used in order to study the impact of the activation. The wafers were then aligned and bonded in an EVG®COMBOND® equipment. Electrical tests performed at the end of full 3D integration on Daisy-Chain structures demonstrated a high connectivity.

articleTitle: Integrating Polycrystalline Diamond with Si for Enhanced Thermal Management in Large-Scale Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: The surface-activated bonding method successfully achieved the room temperature bonding of a 1-inch polycrystalline diamond wafer and a 2-inch silicon wafer, yielding a bonded area of approximately 90%. Additionally, an amorphous layer with a thickness of about 18.5 nm was formed at the as-bonded interface due to Ar beam irradiation during the bonding processes.

articleTitle: Perhydropolysilazane as an Adhesion Layer for Vacuum Sealing Wafer Bonding
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: In this paper, we present a novel vacuum wafer bonding at room temperature using Perhydropolysilazane (PHPS) as an adhesion layer. As PHPS converts into SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> at room temperature with adsorbed water, we applied plasma hydrophilic treatment on the wafer surface to provide the adsorbed water for the PHPS reaction. 4 inch Si wafers were successfully bonded at room temperature under vacuum via a single PHPS layer with plasma treatment. The bonding interface shows a good adhesion and high bond strength. The presented technique will provide a new scheme of wafer bonding at room temperature.

articleTitle: Functional GaN Heterogeneous Integrated Substrate Based on Wafer Bonding and Smart-cut Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: This work focuses on the significant demand for breakthroughs and improvements in chip performance through the monolithic heterogeneous integration of GaN-based materials and devices with foreign substrates in the post-Moore era. It systematically conducts the fabrication of wafer-scale single-crystal GaN film and its heterogeneous integration by ion-cutting technology.

articleTitle: Patterning over the Vertical Sidewall for Wiring Front and Backside Electrodes on the Device Chip
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: A new 3D patterning technique over the vertical sidewall is described for wiring front and backside electrodes on the device chip. The resist layer with the latent image on the water-solvable polymer (polyvinyl alcohol, PVA) film pastes on the chip over the sidewall. After dissolving PVA, 100 μm-wide resist pattern is demonstrated after developing.

articleTitle: Wafer-to-Wafer Bonding for Advanced Manufacturing Nodes
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Wafer-to-wafer bonding is an increasingly utilized technology across a broad spectrum of applications. As these applications diversify, they bring forth new challenges. This paper aims to investigate the key requirements of this process, present an overview of the current state-of-the-art results, and provide a forward-looking perspective on the ongoing developments in this field.

articleTitle: Performance Optimization of Gigawatt-Class DFC-PowerChip Laser System Through Bonding Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: We report on the development of an amplifier laser system for compact particle accelerators, operating at room temperature. The active medium of the amplifier is comprised of periodically bonded Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>+:YAG and sapphire crystals using surface-activated bonding technology.

articleTitle: Preparation of GaN-HEMTs Devices Bonded to 150μ m Thick Diamond Substrate
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: 150μm thick GaN-on-Diamond high electron mobility transistors have been successfully fabricated by surface-activated room-temperature bonding. Surfaces of the both GaN-HEMTs and the 150μm thick diamond substrate are polished and bonded each other with a thin Si interlayer by surface-activated room-temperature bonding. Fabricated devices have demonstrated higher drain current at high drain voltage region in comparison with devices with a conventional structure.

articleTitle: Bonding Potential of Atomic Diffusion Bonding of Wafers Using Oxide Films
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Bonding potential of atomic diffusion bonding (ADB) of wafers at room temperature using oxide films is discussed. The bonded interface for ADB disappears when using Y<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, ZrO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, and GeO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> films, indicating that remarkable atomic diffusion occurred at the interface, probably through a defect avalanche.

articleTitle: Loading Pressure Effects on the Bonded Interface Structure in Atomic Diffusion Bonding Using Thick Au Films
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Atomic diffusion bonding (ADB) using Au(300 nm) film on each side was examined. With 20 MPa loading pressure, ADB in air of wafers was successful. Results indicated grain growth occurring at the bonded interface along the direction parallel to the film plane, even without applying annealing.

articleTitle: Is NaOH Beneficial to Low Temperature Hybrid Bonding Integration?
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: We investigated the mechanical and chemical properties of interfaces involved in Cu/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> hybrid bonding. We quantified the impact of adding diluted NaOH at Cu-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and Cu-Cu bonding interfaces. We demonstrated that a NaOH pre-treatment slightly modifies the reflectivity response of the Cu-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> interface, without incidence on the bonding energy, however. No impact has been observed on Cu-Cu bonding interface.

articleTitle: Environmental Moisture Absorption by Oxide-Coated SI Wafers and Effects on Post-Bonding Void Formation and Bond Quality
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Long storage time of oxide-coated silicon wafers is shown to have detrimental effects on bonding quality. The role of moisture absorption from the environment, it's relationship with oxide layer thickness and possible corrective measures will be investigated.

articleTitle: Ohmic Contact Formation on N-Polar n-GaN Surfaces Exposed by Wafer Bonding and Back Surface Process
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: We expose N-polar surfaces of n-GaN layers epitaxially grown on Si (111) substrates by wafer bonding their Ga-polar surfaces and applying the back surface process, and form ohmic contacts on their N-polar surfaces by evaporating Ti/Al/Ti/Au and annealing. The contact resistance for the N-polar surfaces is approximately over 100 times higher than that for the Ga-polar surfaces of the same n-GaN layers, which suggests that the wafer bonding technologies are promising for fabricating advanced devices on N-polar surfaces.

articleTitle: Development of Single Diamond Substrate and Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Fabrication of large size single-crystal diamond and related devices attracts great efforts to make progress in diamond field. In this work, 2 inch single-crystal substrate has been developed and put into production. First, the temperature field in the MPCVD chamber was adjusted and made an uniform temperature distribution. Second, a growth of 2 inch diamond substrate has been carried out, and the XRD (004) FWHM indicates a low value of 91 arcsec. Based on the substrate, diamond RF and power MOSFETs have been developed, which meets the practical application. Also, the enhanced/depletion model logic circuit has been fabricated.

articleTitle: Evolution of Stacked Image Sensor and Cu-Cu Hybrid Bonding Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: In Cu-Cu hybrid bonding used in stacked image sensors, the connection pad pitch needs to be further scaled down. We realized a connection with a pitch of 0.4 μm, thereby addressing the issues of ultrafine Cu-Cu hybrid bonding using fine, small Cu pads.

articleTitle: Wafer Bonding Enabling Engineered Substrates for Large Application Portfolio
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Wafer bonding is a process used to fuse two semiconductor wafers to create engineered substrates with enhanced properties. The Smart Cut process combines it with hydrogen ions implant and thermal or mechanical stress splitting of a donor wafer, to transfer a thin, uniform layer. This is key for fabricating SOI and other advanced materials.

articleTitle: The Interactions between Formic Acid Vapor and Metallic Surface
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: This report deals with the interactions between formic acid vapor and the surface of commonly used highly conductive metals, Cu and A1. Oxidized copper surface can be perfectly transformed to porous and hydrophilic pure copper at low temperatures down to 160°C using modified formic acid vapor treatment with Pt catalysts, which can be referred to hydrogen radicals decomposed from HCOOH. As for A1, low water contact angle down to 9° can be obtained on sputtered Al surface through VUV irradiation with formic acid vapor. A1-OH and carboxylate ligands account for that. The effect of formic acid vapor pre-treatment on direct metal-metal bonding will be also introduced.

articleTitle: Blade Test to Characterize Bonded Interface Fabricated Using Atomic Diffusion Bonding with Amorphous Si and Al Films
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Blade tests of a bonded interface created by atomic diffusion bonding of wafers using amorphous Si (a-Si) and Al thin films were conducted in air and atmospheric pressure Ar gas. No time decay of the values of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\gamma$</tex> (half the fracture energy of the bonded interface) was found either in air or Ar.

articleTitle: SiC/Si Heterojunction Formed by Direct Wafer Bonding and its Characterization
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: In this work, n-SiC/n-Si heterojunctions were formed by direct wafer bonding and smart-cut technologies. An in-depth evaluation of the SiC/Si bonding interface revealed an exceptionally thin interface layer with decent crystallinity and ohmic conductance. These findings underscore the viability of employing direct wafer bonding technology in the practical fabrication of SiC/Si hybrid devices.

articleTitle: Investigation of Low Temperature Cu/Cu Wafer Bonding for Hybrid Bonding Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Cu/Cu wafer bonding at 200 °C was attempted. With sequential plasma activation, copper oxide was left at bonded interface regardless of the bonding atmosphere. While when Cu wafers were activated by Ar fast atom beam and bonded in low vacuum, O-free and O-rich areas co-existed at the interface.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Wafer Bond Strength Measurement: Fundamentals to Industry Standards
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Measuring bonding strength remains a challenge. The Double Cantilever Beam (DCB) method, used for wafer bonding, lacks standardization and is not suitable for Die-to-Wafer (D2W) samples. Alternative methods like die shear or pull tests can cause bulk silicon failure. Nanoindentation (NI) offers a promising solution, allowing bond strength measurement at various wafer locations and potentially for D2W samples. This study reports on DCB measurements and explores NI for assessing bond strength.

articleTitle: Fabrication and Characterization of GaN HEMT with Nitride Buffer/Diamond Junctions
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: GaN-HEMTs encounter performance and reliability challenges due to self-heating. Therefore, diamond substrates, renowned for their high thermal conductivity, are viewed as the most promising heat spreaders. Using a surface-activated bonding method (SAB), we achieved a GaN//Diamond junction structure by transferring GaN-HEMTs onto a diamond substrate. This approach led to enhanced output compared to conventional structures.

articleTitle: Molecular Direct Bonding and Transfer of 2D MoS2 Layer over a Full 200 mm Silicon Wafer
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: 2D materials offer exceptional properties for microelectronics, yet scaling from lab to industry poses challenges. Processes for growth, transfer, and fabrication need adaptation. Direct bonding transfer without the use of any polymer is of great interest. Demonstration will be done over a full 200 mm silicon substrate.

articleTitle: Correlation between Pre-Bonding Surface and Bond Wave Speed
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: We deeply investigate the pre-bonding surface and the bond wave speed for 300mm wafer level direct/hybrid bonding. The novel analysis methods, SFG and zeta potential, reveal plasma activation effects. The characterization results show us the impact of plasma activation on the bond wave propagation.

articleTitle: Electrical Characteristics of Thick-Metal-Film Interconnects on Silicon Oxide Films by Directly Bonding Al Foils
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: We directly bond 17-μm thick Al foils to 2-μm thick oxide films on Si substrates using the surface activated bonding technology and fabricate thick-metal-film interconnects. We find that the attenuation constant of coplanar waveguides (CPWs) fabricated on the oxide films is smaller than that of CPWs directly fabricated on Si substrates.

articleTitle: Application of Surface Activated Bonding to Determine the Dislocation Generation Process at Asymmetric Grain Boundaries in Silicon
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: An amorphous layer at a Si{111}/Si{115} bonding interface, formed via the surface activated bonding, is examined by using scanning transmission electron microscopy. The recrystallization process of the amorphous layer, accompanied with dislocation generation, is observed in-situ at elevated temperatures above 1000 °C.

articleTitle: Recent Developments on Hydrophilic and Hybrid Direct Bonding Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Hydrophilic direct bonding is currently the most widely used type of direct bonding in the industry, and its fundamental mechanisms have been extensively studied over the past decades. This paper aims to highlight recent developments that have significantly impacted both the fundamental understanding of hydrophilic direct bonding and its industrial applications.

articleTitle: 100 GHz Thin-Film LNOI/Si Optical Modulator Fabricated by Room Temperature Wafer Bonding
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: This paper demonstrated 100 GHz thin-film LNOI/Si optical modulator fabricated by room temperature wafer bonding with activated Si atomic layer.

articleTitle: Optimization of Plating Parameters for Nanocrystalline Copper for Realizing Low Temperature Cu-Cu Bonding
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: This study presents a comprehensive approach to Cu-Cu direct bonding using nanocrystalline Cu (NC-Cu), highlighting the importance of plating parameters such as Cu ion concentration, plating temperature, additive concentration and current density in achieving NC-Cu for strong Cu-Cu bonding. In this study, NC-Cu of 111 nm of grain size with 2ASD current density is electroplated and bonded samples shows promising results.

articleTitle: Evaluating Room Temperature Bonding of SiCN-SiCN Films with Different Compositions
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Silicon carbon nitride (S iCN) has become a potential dielectric material for Cu hybrid bonding. In this work, we examine three kinds of SiCN films as the primary dielectric bonding layers, aiming to identify the best recipe for application. The dies underwent two-step plasma treatment to form hydrophilic surfaces, which is conducive to bonding. Bonding energy, surface roughness, water contact angle, and chemical bonds formation were investigated to characterize the SiCN films.

articleTitle: Low Temperature LiTaO3-to-Si Wafer Bonding
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: In this study, the low-temperature bonding of lithium tantalate (LiTaO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>)-to- silicon (Si) was investigated using plasma activation. In detail the influence of different plasma parameters on the resulting bond was characterized.

articleTitle: Au Flat Micro-Bump Arrays Fabricated by Transfer and Coining of Au Thin Films
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Au flat micro-bump arrays that facilitate low-pressure Au-Au bonding were fabricated by the process based on Au thin film transfer and coining of Au hollow structure. High die shear strength was achieved between Au flat bumps and Au sputter films with a low bonding pressure of 10 MPa at 150°C.

articleTitle: Improving Distribution of Bump Allocation for Bonding Load Uniformity Toward 3D Integration of Superconducting Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: We solve the bonding pressure non-uniformity by the distribution of bump allocation for superconducting device. Resistance measurements at room temperature showed that the devised pattern had 5% lower resistance in the central chain. In both patterns, a superconducting current of more than 20 mA flowed at temperatures below 4.2 K.

articleTitle: Novel IR Laser Release Temporary Bonding Solution for Advanced 3D Stacking and Layer Transfer
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: A novel temporary bonding technology has been developed based on using Si carrier wafers and ultrathin, inorganic IR laser release layers. In comparison to UV laser debonding, the full process flow including the employed materials had to be reconsidered by focusing on the simplicity and a reduced environmental impact. Newly developed LayerRelease™ technology facilitates high-density 2.5 and 3D integration [1], [2], even on nanometer- scale thin layers by providing fusion bondable carrier wafers.

articleTitle: Wafer-Level InP to Si and LiNbO3 Covalent Bonding via Asymmetric Plasma Activation Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: An asymmetric plasma activation strategy was developed for targeted activation towards dissimilar materials. By using the appropriate plasma gases, a balance is achieved between surface functionalization and subsurface regulation to avoid damage formation. Therefore, the defect-free InP/Si and InP/LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> interfaces were constructed at low annealing temperatures for hybrid integrated quantum systems.

articleTitle: Effect of Microstructures on Thermal Expansion of CU Pads in SiO2 Vias for 3D IC Hybrid Bonding
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: The bonding mechanism of Cu/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> hybrid joints relies on the thermal expansion of Cu during the post-annealing process. We employed in-situ heating atomic force microscopy (AFM) to measure the variations in surface topographies upon annealing for various Cu microstructures. The results indicate the Cu microstructures have a significant influence on the thermal expansion of Cu pads. This study provides an approach to measure the Cu expansion directly and contributes the fundamental understanding on mechanisms of Cu/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> hybrid bonding.

articleTitle: Die-to-Wafer Bonding for Heterogenous Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Wafer-to-wafer bonding technology is not always the most suitable when it comes to materials integration or to integration of dies manufactured in different technology nodes. For such situation, bonding of dies to wafers can overcome the limitations of wafer-to-wafer bonding and represent a good path for heterogenous integration applications. This work will present an overview of the different process flows available, the corresponding specifications as well as some representative process results.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Effective Thermal Conductivity in DFC-PowerChip for Highly Intense Laser Gain Media
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Thermal resistance between bonded surfaces in composite media fabricated by inter-layer surface activated bonding (il-SAB) is negligible. It indicates 10-W/mK thermal conductivity of YAG can be enhanced over 27.9-W/mK using DFC-PowerChip by il-SAB.

articleTitle: All-Rounder Hybrid Bond-Cluster for Wafer to Wafer and CO/SEQ Die to Wafer, Room Temperature Assemblies
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Capabilities of the new SUSS XBS300 Gen2 D2W including SET NEO HB for low temperature HB applications.

articleTitle: Bonding for Advanced 3D Logic Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: As traditional transistor scaling nears its limits, packaging and wafer bonding have evolved, enabling 3D stacking and innovations like CFETs. These advancements allow higher transistor density and improved performance, with precise wafer to wafer alignment playing a key role in modern semiconductor technologies.

articleTitle: Effect of Ar-Fast Atom Beam Irradiaon on n-Ga2O3/n-Si Electrical Conductance
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: The present study compares the electrical properties of n-Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/n-Si substrates bonded under different conditions. The results indicate that the Ar fast-atom beam irradiation for the Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> surface deteriorates the electrical conductance at the Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/Si bonding interface.

articleTitle: Structural Variation During Annealing at Diamond/Silicon Heterointerfaces Fabricated by Surface Activated Bonding
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Structural and compositional variation at a diamond/silicon heterointerface, fabricated by surface activated bonding at room temperature, is examined during annealing at temperatures of 600 to 1000 °C, by scanning transmission electron microscopy. The bonding process causes the amorphous layer with carbon and silicon atims at the interface, and the layer is recrystallized at temperatures above about 900 °C, forming a crystalline silicon carbide compounds.

articleTitle: Surface Modification of Cu Films by Gas Cluster IoN Beams Using Organic Acid Vapor for Wafer Bonding
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: In this study, surface modifications with gas cluster ion beams (GCIBs) in organic acid environment were investigated for surface activated bonding. We have reported that GCIBs induce low-damage surface smoothing and surface reactions enhancements. In this study, organic acid vapor such as acetic acid is introduced during GCIB irradiation in order to assist surface oxide removal on Cu films. From XPS and AFM measurements, smooth Cu surface without oxide by Ar-GCIB irradiation with acetic acid were confirmed. Cu bonding experiment using this technique shows lower temperature bonding of Cu compared to Ar-GCIB irradiation without acetic acid vapor.

articleTitle: Thermal Boundary Resistance of Bonded Semiconductor Interfaces
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Thermal interfaces between heterogeneous integrated semiconductors have emerged as a critical bottleneck for effective thermal dissipation. This summary reviews recent advancements, highlighting a significant enhancement in thermal boundary conductance (TBC) following annealing, alongside the development of a novel TBC measurement technique that offers a high signal-to-noise ratio and enables fast TBC mapping.

articleTitle: Room-Temperature Wafer Bonding of P-InP and N-GaAs with P-Ingaas/N-InGaAs Interface
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Room-temperature wafer bondings between a p-InGaAs grown on a p-InP substrate and a n-InGaAs grown on a n-GaAs substrate were investigated, changing the applied voltage of Fast Atom Beam (FAB) irradiation. As a result, a low interface resistance of about 2.0 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Omega \text{cm}^{2}$</tex> was obtained under FAB irradiation with 1.5 kV and 100 mA.

articleTitle: Atomic Diffusion Bonding of Wafers with PDC-SiO2 Underlayers Using Thin Zr Films
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Atomic diffusion bonding of wafers with PDC-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> underlayers using thin Zr films was studied. Light transmittance of the interface bonded using Zr(0.5 nm) films achieved 100<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> after annealing at 300°C, indicating Zr oxide film formation at the bonded interface with dissociated oxygen.

articleTitle: Heat Dissipation Characteristics of GaN-on-Polycrystalline-Diamond HEMTs
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: GaN-on-polycrystalline-diamond (PCD) HEMTs, which exhibited a thermal resistance 70% lower than that of GaN-on-Si HEMTs, revealed heat dissipation characteristics comparable to those of GaN-on-single-crystal-diamond (SCD) HEMTs. These results indicated that PCD) can serve as an effective heat dissipating substrate for GaN HEMTs instead of SCD.

articleTitle: Low Temperature Bonding of Diamond Heat Spreaders for Advanced Thermal Management
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: A novel approach for next generation heat management is presented by bonding single crystal diamonds (SCD) to Si substrates via surface activated bonding and by thermal simulations. The bonds are characterized for thermal resistance, mechanical strength and interface structure.

articleTitle: Nb-In Direct Bonding at Room Temperature Using Surface Activated Bonding
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Bump-shaped of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$50\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex> diameter Nb-In direct bonding at room temperature was performed using a surface activated bonding. The bonding was succeeded, and daisy chain of 2809 bonded bumps through Nb-In interface confirms superconducting critical temperature of 9.05 K.

articleTitle: Low-Thermal Budget TEOS-TEOS Bonding for Multi-Stack HBM Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: In this study, the impact of annealing time with reduced thermal budget on the interfacial bond energy of oxide to oxide has been evaluated. Bonding energy was systematically analyzed under various annealing conditions. Additionally, this work proposed a standardized Maszara's test measurement interval to accurately assess the bonding performance for TEOS-TEOS oxide dielectric interfaces.

articleTitle: Atomic Diffusion Bonding Using SiN Films
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: After atomic diffusion bonding (ADB) of wafers using amorphous SiN films with our bonding equipment (BC7300; Canon ANELVA Corp.), greater than 2 J/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> surface free energy was achieved at the bonded interface using SiN films. The refractive index of the SiN films was 2.0: almost equal to that of Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>.

articleTitle: Cross-sectional Investigation by Dual Bias Modulation Electrostatic Force Microscopy on n-type Si/Si Junction Fabricated by Surface-activated Bonding
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Dual bias modulation electrostatic force microscopy was used to observe a cross section around an n-type Si/Si junction fabricated by surface-activated bonding, and the effect of thermal annealing on interfacial properties was investigated based on the signals taken by dual bias modulation electrostatic force microscopy.

articleTitle: TEOS and Thermal Oxide Low Temperature Direct Wafer Bonding Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Understanding and controlling the dynamic of dielectric direct bonding is key to reach better performance in 3D applications. In this work we will review the experimental parameters that influence this dynamic. Moreover, TEOS deposited oxide bonding performance will be compared to thermal oxide ones.

articleTitle: Hydroxide and Fluoride Catalyzed Bonding Interface Closure for Low Temperature Wafer Bonding
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Surface deposition of active chemicals prior to wafer bonding was recently shown to enhance the hydrophilic direct bonding energy. Here, we describe the catalytic effect of hydroxide and fluoride ions at the bonding interface.

articleTitle: New Insights of Junction Group States Modified by Surface Activation in Interlayer Dielectrics
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: The use of surface-activated bonding (SAB) to bond the interlayer dielectrics used in wafer-level bonding can achieve higher bonding energy at lower temperatures than conventional hydrophilic bonding. In this study, it was observed that the bonding groups modified by the SAB process are unstable and their state has a significant effect on the bonding performance. By analyzing the changes in the surface state after the surface activation process and clarifying the relationship with the bonding energy, it is possible to stably achieve high-energy bonding of 2 J/m <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>or more by low-temperature annealing at 200°C.

articleTitle: Reliability of Full-Face Diffusion Bonding with AG Coated AL Foil under Thermal Stress
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: A thermal shock test was performed to assess the bond reliability of a novel thermocompression bonding method utilizing a silver-top multilayered Al alloy base foil, designed for full-face diffusion bonding. The observation of cohesive fractures within the Al layer indicates high bond reliability.

articleTitle: A Systematic Approach for Tuning Plasma-Specific Process Results in Plasma-Activated Low-Temperature Wafer-to-Wafer Bonding
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: In the context of semiconductor device processing, managing the thermal budget is crucial. Plasma-activated wafer bonding (PAWB) enables a significant reduction of required temperatures by modifying the chemistry of the (sub-)surfaces layers of the treated substrate. It is critical to understand the physical mechanisms and effects of plasma activation, regardless of surface layer composition. Furthermore, precise process control is equally crucial. This work aims to elucidate how advanced plasma process control can be realized. Measuring the total charge accumulated during plasma activation using current-voltage probes in combination with post-activation ellipsometry, bond wave monitoring and patterned wafer geometry (PWG) measurements enable new insights on the plasma process effect on oxide thickness growth, bond wave speed and residual in-plane distortion (IPD). The addition of bond strength measurements after thermal annealing for various temperatures completes the parameter set commonly monitored to qualify the direct bonding process. The knowledge gained can be directly applied to tune plasma-activation processes according to the specific requirements of individual products in future applications.

articleTitle: Investigations on Low-Temperature Aluminium Thermocompression Bonding Using Surface Passivation Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: In this study, the low-temperature metal bonding of aluminum (AI) was investigated using an in-situ surface passivation. Specifically, the influence of a passivation layer was investigated with regard to sufficient reduction in the aluminium oxide layer. Bonding was performed on both unpatterned and patterned wafers, evaluating interface quality using scanning acoustic microscopy (SAM), scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and shear test.

articleTitle: Review of Wafer Bonding for High Power Device Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: Low temperature wafer bonding offers another processing step to realize novel power electronic devices. This talk will review such devices and look forward to novel devices and engineered substrates realized by low temperature wafer bonding.

articleTitle: 20-mm-Square GaN/Diamond Bonding Without Vacuum Process
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: A 20-mm-square diamond substrate was bonded with a 2-inch-diameter GaN wafer by hydrophilic bonding method. Both substrates were cleaned with an NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>OH/H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> mixture and then bonded at 200 °C under atmospheric conditions. The diamond substrate planarized by plasma-assisted polishing was bonded without visible voids. As this simple process enables relatively large-scale GaN/diamond bonding, it would contribute to future GaN-on-diamond devices.

articleTitle: The Use of Glasses in Low-Temperature Wafer Bonding Processes
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: The bonding temperature is becoming an increasingly critical parameter regarding both device functionality and for the process itself, in terms of time and cost aspects. This paper demonstrates that even for classical bonding processes, such as anodic and glass frit bonding temperatures can be reduced, thereby conferring benefits.

articleTitle: Direct Fusion Bonding Using HfO2 as Dielectric
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: HfO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is used as direct fusion bonding dielectric, the void formation mechanism will be investigated. Successful direct fusion bonding between a borosilicate wafer and HfO2 bonding dielectric will be demonstrated.

articleTitle: Ga2O3-Diamond Heterogeneous Bonding at Room Temperature and Interfacial Thermal Stress Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: A room temperature bonding of thick film <100>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> with diamond substrate was performed via in-situ deposition of Si nanolayers. The ratio of bonded area of 85% was achieved. For thick film heterogeneous materials, an interface stress characterization method based on variable temperature focused Raman technology was developed to provide guidance for subsequent high temperature processes.

articleTitle: Fabrication of GaN-on-Diamond HEMT Structures Using PCD on a Back Plate for Low Cost and High Heat Dissipation
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: The self-heating in GaN-HEMTs poses a significant challenge, leading to diminished device performance and reliability. Consequently, there is growing interest in utilizing diamond, renowned for its exceptionally high thermal conductivity, as a heat-spreading material for HEMTs. In this study, we aimed to fabricate GaN-HEMTs on polycrystalline diamond grown on a back plate, aiming to achieve low-cost GaN-on-diamond HEMT structures utilizing the surface-activated bonding method.

articleTitle: Room Temperature Bonding of SiO2 Wafers Using ALD Al2O3 Ultrathin Film
publicationTitle: 2024 8th International Workshop on Low Temperature Bonding for 3D Integration (LTB-3D)
abstract: This paper focuses on surface activated bonding (SAB) of ALD Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> ultrathin films. SAB method using 2 nm thick Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>films was found to produce a strong bond between SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> at room temperature.
